blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The census has no runtime supply denominator. Direct reads found Ethereum totalSupply=1.979688 shares at block 26224667 and Plume totalSupply=0 at block 100304741 (2026-10-19T06:18:16+00:00); within the two authored deployments Ethereum is 100% of outstanding supply. This is the legacy inALPHA address, not the new nALPHA address listed by the current Nest API. Ethereum 0x64ab176c545bb85eca75d53c3ffcb361deafb855 is a verified non-proxy BoringVault. At block 26224667 (2026-10-19T05:55:35Z), owner()=0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982; the existing owner-authorized exit(to,asset,assetAmount,from,shareAmount) burns shares from arbitrary from without holder allowance, and assetAmount may be zero. Thus an active arbitrary-holder privileged burn, not merely an upgrade/pause possibility, establishes Yes. A read-only eth_call from the owner to exit with zero amounts succeeded; no transaction was submitted. hook() was zero: no active transfer blacklist is claimed for this deployment; the existing arbitrary-holder burn is independently sufficient.  Nest terms section 6.2 expressly describe freezing suspicious wallets and Kimber Labs limited administration, consistent with these directly verified controls. No parent is declared. Reserve exposure cannot displace the higher-priority direct Yes verdict; no reserve-majority measurement is used as its basis.

oracleRisk.summary: The legacy inALPHA share price is a stored exchange rate, not an external market feed. Verified Ethereum source for the exact vault accountant 0xa65E054d2d9f7a9789065e0A6381132EFbD41A90 (AccountantWithRateProviders, immutable vault 0x64Ab176C545bb85EcA75d53c3Ffcb361dEafb855) shows getRate() returning accountantState.exchangeRate, and the only writer is the Auth-gated updateExchangeRate(uint96), which is bounded by allowedExchangeRateChangeUpper/Lower and pauses the contract when a move exceeds the bounds or arrives before the minimum update delay. Blockscout logs show an operator key 0x450545F4cC7425DDe582091a7fe9E63471Af1045 pushing 964007 -> 959091 -> 954200 on 2026-02-23 (last update block 24521103, 2026-02-23T17:32:59Z), and Nest's own API serves the same 0.9542 rate with updatedAt 1771867995 on chains 1 and 98866. No external price feed is consumed for the coin rate; the NAV is set by Nest operations under on-chain bounds and has not moved since February 2026. A pinned read at Ethereum block 26300432 (2026-10-29T19:16:23Z) returns getRate() = 954200, vault() = 0x64ab176c545bb85eca75d53c3ffcb361deafb855 and owner() = 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982, the same Nest Safe that owns the vault.

branchApplicability.rationale: The legacy inALPHA BoringVault has no borrower market, collateral ratio, liquidation or bad-debt path: mint and redeem pricing consume the accountant exchange rate, so there is no liquidation-branch inventory to review. The single pricing path is the privileged accountant update reviewed here.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum and Plume each host a reviewed inALPHA BoringVault native-issuance deployment at 0x64ab176c545bb85eca75d53c3ffcb361deafb855 under the same Nest 3-of-6 Safe and the current authorized Teller 0x20428f901a50ec69f5a2b56d313491cc686fafff; these native issuance facts remain in Mint Authority. Nest's official materials describe LayerZero OFT share movement for legacy BoringVaults and the inALPHA config records that route type and peers, but no live inALPHA NestVaultOFT/NestShareOFT address pair or current delegate, upgrade admin, peer, DVN/ULN, executor, pause, or rate-limit state is identified. No bridge representation or controller is invented; the bridge tier remains opaque-or-unknown pending reconciliation of the exact route.
